head: Offline navigation app DeadZone maps hikes and trips without signal
dek: DeadZone: Offline Navigation, a $3.99 iPhone and iPad app, lets you download maps and track your route where there's no cell coverage, for hiking, cycling, hunting, camping and off-road trips. It was #56 among paid Navigation apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: It has trail discovery, saved places, a GPS breadcrumb trail, trip checklists, a compass, a flashlight and sound signals. Searching for new trails and live conditions may not work offline. The listing says it works without an account and is an extra tool, not a replacement for emergency gear or official maps; its flashlight and signals don't call emergency services. The maker is Bella Luna Tech, and the app is out since 21 November.
means: If you head into places without signal, the app keeps your map and route on the phone instead of relying on a connection.
todo: Download the maps for your area before you leave coverage, and still carry a paper map or emergency device on remote trips.
